verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a biometric or PIN lock on the 2FAS Auth or 2FAS Pass app. The 2FAS Pass 'Security Tiers' and the requirement to confirm extension or autofill access in the app are adjacent item-access controls, not an app-level lock that would protect codes on a borrowed phone.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes
